spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (ओखति) (इ) उखि (उंखति)
1 To go, to move or approach.
2 To dry, to wither.
3 To adorn. The first retains the diphthong with a prefix ending in अ, as प्र and ओखति make प्रोखति.

f. (-खा)
A pot or saucepan, &c.
E.
उख to go, क affix, and टाप्, also उघा.

m. (-लः)
A kind of grass, a sort of Andropogon.
